text:
Before your gaze,

there was not, nor will there be after-spring.

Because we live from what endures

and not from what we were.

From that perhaps of the loved and seen:

the Creator's term in the creature...

I am not I, but rather the perfume that preserves me in you,

and sums up the remainder the hours corrode.

But do not weep: in my day there is more dream and wisdom

than in the vague centuries of man.

translation.title: Before Your Gaze...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the source's strange after-spring compound and the speaker as perfume preserved in another.
